claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve validates known simple prompt placeholders, dry-runs template formatting, validates configured AlphaEvolve-style mutation-channel requirements, checks prompt-format fragments and markers, preserves parent placeholders for evolved prompt children, records prompt-program identity, records template_sha256 identity, and intentionally preserves duplicate prompt text as independent prompt arms. It does not claim a role-specific template compatibility matrix, mutation runtime role compatibility policy, critique prompt template compatibility policy, feedback prompt template compatibility policy, meta-prompt call-surface compatibility policy, context-policy compatibility matrix, duplicate-arm semantic equivalence audit, prompt-template dedup design, or human-reviewed role-surface fixtures.
source_claim: AlphaEvolve builds prompts from task instructions, previous programs, evaluator feedback, and stochastic prompt templates; templates must remain compatible with the prompt roles and context channels that consume them
